scope: Primary-source final review of Chengdu Museum and Sanxingdui Museum ticketing, opening hours, and foreign-visitor guidance.

records.name: Chengdu Museum
notes: Official English visitor guide confirms weekday-specific hours, last entry, Monday closure exceptions, visitor cap, peak periods, address and metro access.
The project's price remains recorded as CNY 0 based on its existing entry, but reservation and passport-specific booking procedures are not elevated to verified in this batch.
Do not imply that a foreign passport booking flow is guaranteed; recommend official channel and service-desk assistance if needed.

records.name: Sanxingdui Museum
notes: Official museum guide confirms adult ticket CNY 72, individual reservation through official website/WeChat/Douyin, daily 20:00 release up to five days ahead, and non-authorisation of third-party sellers.
Official guide provides an inbound-tourist booking route and says successful reservations should be exchanged at the ticket centre with the original booking document.
Regular exhibition hall hours 08:30–18:00 with ticket checking stopping 17:00; Restoration Hall 09:00–18:00. Selected periods extend hours to 20:00.
Chinese-language official guide lists concession categories; foreign visitor eligibility is not inferred.
